purpose: Who writes which files so two lanes cannot stage each other's work.
honest_limits: Railway production is one container. factory-2 is a local worktree, not a second cloud factory.
The live POST /factory/ship-queue-and-commit path has no factory_id and always writes factory-1's tree.
node_modules on factory-2 is a symlink into factory-1. Acceptable for parallel_split of different files. Not acceptable for redundant_independent of the same slice.

lanes.current_job: Production governed ship of services/routes/migrations. Must skip native/macos-overlay even if LANE_ASSIGNMENT.json is missing (FALLBACK_LANES).

lanes.dispatch: local worktree on branch factory/factory-2, synced to origin/main
lanes.current_job: Local loop: sync worktree, compile Taloa.app when native/macos-overlay changes, hold-to-talk on the badge (TALOA-BADGE-VOICE-001).

collision_rule: A file path is owned by exactly one lane. If a job needs both native and server files, split it into two slices at the path boundary; do not let both lanes open the same file.
